CustomField.description: Timestamp the verbal wire verification was logged. Migrated from Task.Verified_At__c and RENAMED to the canonical form, matching Wire__c.Verified_DateTime__c so the two sides of a wire read alike. NOTE FOR THE MIGRATION: Wire__c carries a validation rule refusing a Verified_DateTime__c more than about one minute from NOW, so historical values cannot be loaded onto Wire__c. That rule is object-scoped to Wire__c and does NOT apply here, so historical checklist evidence migrates cleanly - do not add an equivalent rule to this object without re-reading that constraint.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date and time the verbal verification call was logged. Set automatically when verification is recorded.
CustomField.label: Verified DateTime
